pull_request.title: Tracker: Plan whole-tracker design and staged performance studies
pull_request.head: design/tracker-system-plan
pull_request.body:
## Change

Propose the whole-tracker design programme in **DES-005** for review and sign-off. [Read the consolidated plan](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/9f984e85e35c109aef3560493cf67388de06b728/docs/design/DES-005-tracker-system-plan.md), including the four role inputs and sixteen follow-on work packages.

Retain the established envelope and fixed tracking coverage of |η| < 4, starting from ODD-guided pixels, short strips/strixels and stereo long strips. Progress through parametric estimates, ACTS active coverage, material/field studies, fast fitting and reconstruction, human system-design review, and later DD4hep/Geant4 validation. Component and service work run in parallel; beamspot sensitivity enters before layout freeze and is repeated in final validation.

Integrate the existing pixel-module work (#7 / #8) and magnetic studies (#6 / #9) through pinned dependencies. The source catalogue, dashboard tasks and curated session records accompany the plan.

## Review and sign-off requested

Requested reviewer: **asalzburger-review**. Review target: `9f984e85e35c109aef3560493cf67388de06b728`.

Please assess and, if satisfactory, explicitly approve the **staged programme, role responsibilities, dependencies and evidence gates**, recording any conditions against that revision. Key review points:

- Whether the sequence and task boundaries provide credible performance evidence early enough to guide the layout.
- Whether pixel/strip, support, cooling, power/readout and field interfaces cover the necessary inputs.
- Whether the proposed coverage, beamspot, material, field and timing comparisons give suitable decision gates.
- How to assign the remaining numerical performance criteria, luminous distribution, operating/occupancy scenarios and human technical/expert responsibilities.

DES-005 remains DRAFT with review and plan sign-off requested. Plan sign-off has bounded scope: numerical criteria, layer/component choices, production implementation and physics acceptance retain their later review requirements. No approval or detector performance is claimed by this PR. IdRes access succeeded; public reproducibility/licensing and adapter validation remain intake work, with an analytic fallback documented.

## Named review coverage

The [reviewer comment](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/11#issuecomment-5729274384) is incorporated into the plan and task routing:

- **Markus Elsing and Noemi Calace:** general tracker layout, layer positioning, overall parametric performance, hits/track studies and material-budget estimates. Noemi’s invitation is sent; acceptance is not yet recorded. Markus’s invitation/acceptance state is not recorded.
- **`paulgessinger`:** DD4hep–ACTS interplay. Participation acceptance is not recorded.
- **`asalzburger-review`:** final sign-off authority, unchanged.

The supportive comment and reviewer nominations do not record formal plan sign-off. Other specialist assignments remain open.

## Dashboard and validation

- [x] Updated project tracking and recorded the pending review against the exact plan revision.
- [x] Publication checks passed: 25 dashboard/update-policy tests, 15 logging/documentation tests, dashboard validation/build, session validation (34 records), exact-review-target and whitespace checks. Source-reference checks passed during plan preparation.
- [x] Preserved human approval boundaries and linked exact input/review revisions.

No tracker physics simulation was run for this planning PR.

events.text:
SysArch coordinated the host/input contract, independent helix crossing/material
screen and consolidated review documents. TrackTech extracted public pinned ODD
placement references, proposed A/B and challenged component/service assumptions.
PhysVal independently calculated ray coverage and free transverse covariance and
audited IdRes. SoftEng installed the pinned tool and plotting environment,
exercised a supplied example, audited conventions and wrote the nODD adapter.
Role contributions are AI assistance, not human review.

A extends narrow pixel disks. B adds two disks per side and widens downstream
pixels, holding the barrel/strip layout fixed. Both retain pixels, strixels and
effective stereo long-strip stations. Proposed geometry/response/material values
are unsigned design choices. DES-001 stays a dependency, not a duplicated design.

Recommendation: A is the smaller resource control; B adds redundancy but does
not solve the short forward radial lever arm. Both have a three-pixel transition
weakness. B adds about 74% total ideal pixel area. At eta 4 from origin, nominal
3 T, its inverse-momentum precision improves slightly at high pT but worsens
about 7% at 1 GeV pT under the material scenario. Large inverse-momentum errors
must not be described as Gaussian fractional momentum resolution. Neither is
selected for production.

IdRes revision `d54d0e3c465cc0308becb737b04364ce5c68ce16` compiled unchanged
with GSL 2.8 and Apple clang 17. Ignored durable installation:
`reference/cache/idres`; plotting environment: `reference/cache/idres-venv`;
raw inputs/results: `reference/cache/idres-study`. Anonymous public distribution
and licensing remain unresolved; no source, examples or private endpoints are
committed. The analytic controls remain publicly runnable without IdRes.
